title: simonlin1212/TradingAgents-astock
claim: Deep A-share fork of the 65k★ TradingAgents paper framework: 7 AI analysts debate bull/bear under China-market rules with A-share-native data (龙虎榜/游资/解禁) — Apache-2.0, pip-install, zero external services.
why_good: Localization is a moat the US-centric upstream can't casually replicate: T+1 and price-limit rules, 龙虎榜 and 解禁 signals aren't in the original. 708 forks (26% of stars) says Chinese quants adopt it as a base layer, not a bookmark.
value: Credible path is paid A-share data + hosted 'AI 投研' on top of the open core — backtest infra, research output, or white-label for brokers and fintechs serving retail that can't use US-built tools.
risk: Self-declared research/teaching reproduction ('not investment advice') — productizing walks into CSRC investment-advisory licensing; and upstream TradingAgents or a funded clone could ship official multi-market support.
